spec.title: Self-Observability
spec.description: OpenTelemetry SDK self-observability: internal otel.sdk.* metrics and metric cardinality overflow. Services reporting either signal appear automatically in the Service selector.

variables.name: service_name
variables.label: Service
variables.description: Services reporting SDK internal metrics or cardinality overflow in the selected time range.

panels.title: Services reporting
panels.description: Number of services currently emitting OpenTelemetry SDK self-observability metrics.

panels.title: Spans exported
panels.description: Rate of spans that finished exporting successfully (`error_type` empty) across the selected services. See "Export errors" for the failed portion of the same counter.

panels.title: LogRecords exported
panels.description: Rate of LogRecords that finished exporting successfully (`error_type` empty) across the selected services. See "Export errors" for the failed portion of the same counter.

panels.title: Metric data points exported
panels.description: Rate of metric data points that finished exporting successfully (`error_type` empty) across the selected services. See "Export errors" for the failed portion of the same counter.

panels.title: Export errors
panels.description: Rate of spans, LogRecords, and metric data points whose export attempt finished with `error_type` set (the failed complement of the three "exported" panels above). A non-zero value means the exporter could not deliver telemetry to the collector/backend.

panels.title: Items in-flight
panels.description: Telemetry items (spans, LogRecords, and metric data points) currently passed to an exporter but not yet exported (in-flight), summed across all signals.

panels.title: Processing errors (spans + LogRecords)
panels.description: Rate of spans and LogRecords DROPPED by their processor's queue before ever reaching the exporter (spans + LogRecords only -- metrics have no processor stage). A non-zero value means `queue_full` or `already_shutdown` drops are happening; see the per-signal "processed error rate" panels in the Span pipeline / Log pipeline rows below for the breakdown.

panels.title: Spans processed successfully
panels.description: Rate of spans successfully accepted by span processors (`error_type` empty). This measures processor throughput, not successful export.

panels.title: LogRecords processed successfully
panels.description: Rate of LogRecords successfully accepted by log processors (`error_type` empty). This measures processor throughput, not successful export.

panels.title: Spans started rate
panels.description: Rate of spans started by the SDK (`otel.sdk.span.started`). Includes non-recording spans.

panels.title: Live spans
panels.description: Number of live (started but not yet ended) recording spans (`otel.sdk.span.live`).

panels.title: Span processor queue utilization
panels.description: Batch span processor queue utilization: current queue size as a fraction of capacity (`otel.sdk.processor.span.queue.size` / `otel.sdk.processor.span.queue.capacity`). At 100% the queue is full and the processor starts dropping new spans (reported as `error_type="queue_full"` in the "Spans processed error rate" panel below).

queries.query: sum by (service_name, otel_component_name) (otel_sdk_processor_span_queue_size{service_name=~"$service_name"}) / sum by (service_name, otel_component_name) (otel_sdk_processor_span_queue_capacity{service_name=~"$service_name"})

panels.title: Spans processed error rate (by error type)
panels.description: Rate of spans that were DROPPED by the span processor (never reached the exporter), broken down by `error.type` (this panel excludes the success case -- see "Spans started rate" for total volume). `error_type` is `queue_full` (the processor's queue was full) or `already_shutdown` (submitted after the processor was shut down). Should be flat zero in a healthy system.

panels.title: Spans exported error rate (by error type)
panels.description: Rate of FAILED span export operations, broken down by `error.type` (this panel excludes the success case -- see "Spans exported" in the Overview row for the success rate). A non-zero value means the export call itself failed, e.g. `timeout` or a connection error -- distinct from processor-side `queue_full` drops shown in "Spans processed error rate" above. Should be flat zero in a healthy system.

panels.title: Spans in-flight
panels.description: Spans passed to an exporter but not yet exported (`otel.sdk.exporter.span.inflight`).

panels.title: Span export operation duration (avg)
panels.description: Average duration of the span exporter's export call (`otel.sdk.exporter.operation.duration`, filtered to span exporters). Distinct from "Spans exported error rate", which measures success/failure, not latency. Shown as an average (sum/count) rather than a percentile because the SDK currently reports this histogram with a single `+Inf` bucket, which makes `histogram_quantile` always return NaN.

queries.query: sum by (service_name, otel_component_type) (rate(otel_sdk_exporter_operation_duration_seconds_sum{service_name=~"$service_name",otel_component_type=~".*span_exporter"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service_name, otel_component_type) (rate(otel_sdk_exporter_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",otel_component_type=~".*span_exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: LogRecords created rate
panels.description: Rate of LogRecords submitted to enabled SDK loggers (`otel.sdk.log.created`).

panels.title: LogRecords exported error rate (by error type)
panels.description: Rate of FAILED LogRecord export operations, broken down by `error.type` (this panel excludes the success case -- see "LogRecords exported" in the Overview row for the success rate). A non-zero value means the export call itself failed, e.g. `timeout` or a connection error. Should be flat zero in a healthy system.

panels.title: Log processor queue utilization
panels.description: Batch LogRecord processor queue utilization: current queue size as a fraction of capacity (`otel.sdk.processor.log.queue.size` / `otel.sdk.processor.log.queue.capacity`). At 100% the queue is full and the processor starts dropping new LogRecords (reported as `error_type="queue_full"` in the "LogRecords processed error rate" panel below).

queries.query: sum by (service_name, otel_component_name) (otel_sdk_processor_log_queue_size{service_name=~"$service_name"}) / sum by (service_name, otel_component_name) (otel_sdk_processor_log_queue_capacity{service_name=~"$service_name"})

panels.title: LogRecords processed error rate (by error type)
panels.description: Rate of LogRecords that were DROPPED by the log processor (never reached the exporter), broken down by `error.type` (this panel excludes the success case -- see "LogRecords created rate" for total volume). `error_type` is `queue_full` (the processor's queue was full) or `already_shutdown` (submitted after the processor was shut down). Should be flat zero in a healthy system.

panels.title: LogRecords in-flight
panels.description: LogRecords passed to an exporter but not yet exported (`otel.sdk.exporter.log.inflight`).

panels.title: LogRecord export operation duration (avg)
panels.description: Average duration of the LogRecord exporter's export call (`otel.sdk.exporter.operation.duration`, filtered to log exporters). Distinct from "LogRecords exported error rate", which measures success/failure, not latency. Shown as an average (sum/count) rather than a percentile because the SDK currently reports this histogram with a single `+Inf` bucket, which makes `histogram_quantile` always return NaN.

queries.query: sum by (service_name, otel_component_type) (rate(otel_sdk_exporter_operation_duration_seconds_sum{service_name=~"$service_name",otel_component_type=~".*log_exporter"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service_name, otel_component_type) (rate(otel_sdk_exporter_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",otel_component_type=~".*log_exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Metric data points exported error rate (by error type)
panels.description: Rate of FAILED metric data point export operations, broken down by `error.type` (this panel excludes the success case -- see "Metric data points exported" in the Overview row for the success rate). A non-zero value means the export call itself failed, e.g. `timeout` or a connection error. Should be flat zero in a healthy system.

panels.title: Metric data points in-flight
panels.description: Metric data points passed to an exporter but not yet exported (`otel.sdk.exporter.metric_data_point.inflight`).

panels.title: Metric collect duration (avg)
panels.description: Average duration of the metric reader's collect step (`otel.sdk.metric_reader.collection.duration`). This is metric-pipeline specific. Shown as an average (sum/count) rather than a percentile because the SDK currently reports this histogram with a single `+Inf` bucket, which makes `histogram_quantile` always return NaN.

panels.title: Metric export operation duration (avg)
panels.description: Average duration of the metric exporter's export call (`otel.sdk.exporter.operation.duration`, filtered to metric exporters), if the SDK reports it. Distinct from "Metric collect duration" (the reader's collect step) and from "Metric data points exported error rate" (success/failure, not latency). Shown as an average (sum/count) rather than a percentile because the SDK currently reports this histogram with a single `+Inf` bucket, which makes `histogram_quantile` always return NaN.

queries.query: sum by (service_name, otel_component_type) (rate(otel_sdk_exporter_operation_duration_seconds_sum{service_name=~"$service_name",otel_component_type=~".*metric_exporter"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service_name, otel_component_type) (rate(otel_sdk_exporter_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service_name",otel_component_type=~".*metric_exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: SDK components reporting
panels.description: SDK components (exporters, processors, metric readers) reporting self-observability, per service. Derived from `otel.component.type` / `otel.component.name`.

panels.title: Services with overflow observed
panels.description: Distinct services with an overflow point reported in the selected time range. Zero means no overflow observed, not proof that every SDK supports or reports cardinality limits.

panels.title: Interpreting overflow
panels.content:
Overflow preserves measurement values but loses their measurement attributes.

For synchronous instruments:
- **Cumulative:** once capacity is exhausted, new attribute combinations continue overflowing until SDK state is reset, typically by restarting the service. Previously tracked combinations continue normally.
- **Delta:** overflow can stop in subsequent collection cycles when active cardinality falls below the limit.

This dashboard shows overflow **observed within the selected time range**, which can remain visible after recovery.

[Learn about cardinality limits](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/signals/metrics/#cardinality-limits)

panels.title: Metrics with overflow observed
panels.description: One row per metric, service instance, and scope observed in the selected time range. Classic histogram components are grouped under their base Prometheus name only when matching _bucket series with an le label are present for the same service instance and scope. The suffix regex extracts a candidate base name; unmatched names are preserved. A row indicates presence, not lost measurement count, configured limit, or current overflow activity.

queries.query: group by (metric, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) ((label_replace(group by (__name__, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) (last_over_time({otel_metric_overflow="true",service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__range])), "metric", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)_(bucket|sum|count)") and on (metric, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) label_replace(group by (__name__, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) (last_over_time({otel_metric_overflow="true",service_name=~"$service_name",__name__=~".+_bucket",le!=""}[$__range])), "metric", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)_bucket")) or label_replace((label_replace(group by (__name__, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) (last_over_time({otel_metric_overflow="true",service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__range])), "metric", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)_(bucket|sum|count)") unless on (metric, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) label_replace(group by (__name__, service_namespace, service_name, service_instance_id, otel_scope_name, otel_scope_version) (last_over_time({otel_metric_overflow="true",service_name=~"$service_name",__name__=~".+_bucket",le!=""}[$__range])), "metric", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)_bucket")), "metric", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)"))
